options.name: amm
options.description: Should Automatic Memory Management be used (memory_target, memory_max_target)

options.name: archivelog
options.description: Puts the database in archivelog/noarchivelog mode when true/false Leaves archivelog mode unchanged when omitted or set to None

options.name: cdb
options.description: Should the database be a container database

options.name: characterset
options.description: The database characterset

options.name: customscripts
options.description: List of scripts to run after database is created e.g customScripts: [/tmp/xxx.sql, /tmp/yyy.sql]

options.name: datafile_dest
options.description: Where the database files should be placed (ASM diskgroup or filesystem path)

options.name: db_name
options.description: The name of the database

options.name: db_options
options.description: JSERVER: true ORACLE_TEXT:false IMEDIA: false CWMLITE: false SPATIAL: false OMS: false APEX: false DV: false

options.name: db_type
options.description: Default Type of database (MULTIPURPOSE, OLTP, DATA_WAREHOUSING)

options.name: db_unique_name
options.description: The database db_unique_name

options.name: dbconfig_type
options.default: SI on standalone, RAC on clustered environment
options.description: Type of database (SI,RAC,RON)

options.name: dbsnmp_password
options.description: Password for the dbsnmp user If not set, defaults to sys_password

options.name: default_tablespace
options.description: Database default permanent tablespace (DEFAULT_PERMANENT_TABLESPACE)

options.name: default_tablespace_type
options.description: Database default tablespace type (DEFAULT_TBS_TYPE)

options.name: default_temp_tablespace
options.description: Database default temporary tablespace (DEFAULT_TEMP_TABLESPACE)

options.name: flashback
options.description: Enables/disables flashback for the database when true/false Leaves flashback unchanged when omitted or set to None

options.name: force_logging
options.description: Enables/disables force logging for the Database when true/false Leaves force logging unchanged when omitted or set to None

options.name: initparams
options.description: List of key=value pairs e.g. initparams: { "sga_target": "1GB", "sga_max_size": "1GB" }

options.name: memory_percentage
options.description: The database total memory in % of available memory

options.name: memory_totalmb
options.description: The database total memory in MB. Defaults to 2G

options.name: nodelist
options.default: On RAC cluster default value is a list of all nodes
options.description: The list of nodes a RAC DB should be created on

options.name: omf
options.description: Use OMF (Oracle manageded files)

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: The home where the database will be created If not provided, environment variable ORACLE_HOME has to be set

options.name: racone_service
options.description: If dbconfig_type = RACONENODE, a service has to be created along with the DB. This is the name of that service If no name is defined, the service will be called "{{ db_name }}_ronserv"

options.name: recoveryfile_dest
options.description: Where the database files should be placed (ASM diskgroup or filesystem path)

options.name: responsefile
options.description: The name of responsefile

options.name: sid
options.description: Sid(System identifier) of newly created database NOTE: Database can have SID, DB_NAME, DB_UNIQUE_NAME and Cluster resource name. DBCA is quite cryptic when generating these names When sid is omitted, db_name=TESTDB, db_unique_name=TESTDB_LA, ORACLE_SID becomes TESTDBLA1, Cluster resource name becomes testdb_la db_unique_name has precedence over db_name when sid is not specified

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the database

options.name: storage_type
options.description: Type of underlying storage (Filesystem or ASM)

options.name: supplemental_logging
options.description: Enables/Disables supplemental (minimal) logging for the Database when true/false Leaves supplemental logging unchanged when omitted or set to None

options.name: sys_password
options.description: Password for the sys user

options.name: system_password
options.description: Password for the system user If not set, defaults to sys_password

options.name: template
options.description: The template the database will be based off
